notes.deviation_from_default_template: NemoGuard's React frontend calls '/api/v2/...' endpoints directly (not the Axet template's generic '/backend/api/' method+action endpoint). The .flows middleware/nginx layer in front of this app must proxy '/api/*' requests through to backendBaseUrl (FastAPI on port 8000) for the frontend to work unmodified. See HOW-TO-START.md and DEPLOY-TO-AXET.md.
